title: Senior QC/R&D
description: Company Description Sika is a speciality chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector towards greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024. Job Description Job Purpose Lead the Quality Control and Research and Development functions to ensure consistent product quality, develop and improve construction chemical formulations, and support efficient manufacturing. Drive innovation, cost optimization, and technical problem-solving while ensuring that products meet approved specifications, customer requirements, applicable standards, and Sika’s technical and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Quality Control and Product Conformity Manage the inspection and testing of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediate products, and finished goods against approved specifications. Establish and maintain sampling plans, testing methods, acceptance criteria, and traceable quality records. Oversee material and finished-product release decisions within delegated authority, ensuring that nonconforming materials are identified, segregated, and controlled. Investigate quality deviations, batch failures, and recurring defects with Production and other relevant functions; verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. Monitor quality trends and recommend improvements to product consistency, testing reliability, and manufacturing processes. 2. Research and Product Development Lead the development, localization, and improvement of construction chemical products within the assigned portfolio. Translate market needs and customer requirements into defined development projects with Sales, Marketing, and Technical teams. Plan laboratory experiments, performance evaluations, application trials, and stability studies to validate new and modified formulations. Coordinate with Sika’s regional and global R&D teams on technology transfer, technical approvals, and knowledge sharing. Maintain a prioritized development pipeline with clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, and progress reporting. 3. Raw Materials and Formulation Optimization Evaluate alternative raw materials and suppliers with Procurement to improve supply continuity, product performance, and cost efficiency. Lead formulation optimization initiatives while maintaining required quality, safety, application performance, and shelf life. Ensure that material substitutions and formulation changes are tested, documented, and approved before implementation. Support initiatives to reduce waste and environmental impact, with appropriate technical validation of resulting product claims. 4. Production Support and Industrialization Lead the technical transfer of approved formulations from laboratory trials to pilot and commercial production. Establish manufacturing instructions, process parameters, and quality checkpoints with Production. Support troubleshooting of processing difficulties and product performance issues, identifying sustainable technical solutions. Work with Technical Service and Sales to investigate customer complaints, conduct relevant testing, and recommend corrective actions. Provide technical training on product characteristics, testing requirements, and manufacturing controls. 5. Laboratory Management and Safety Manage laboratory capacity, workloads, equipment, consumables, and testing priorities to support production and development requirements. Ensure that instruments are calibrated, maintained, and suitable for their intended tests. Maintain effective sample identification, retention, storage, and disposal arrangements. Ensure safe laboratory practices, chemical handling, housekeeping, and waste management in coordination with EHS. Maintain reliable and complete experimental records and test results. 6. Quality Systems and Technical Documentation Maintain controlled formulations, specifications, test methods, manufacturing instructions, and technical records. Ensure that approved formulation changes are accurately reflected in bills of materials and relevant systems. Support ISO 9001 requirements and applicable internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits. Coordinate product testing and certification against applicable Egyptian and international standards. Support accurate product data, safety documentation, and labelling with the responsible functions. Protect confidential formulations, technical information, and intellectual property. 7. People Leadership and Department Management Set objectives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor the performance of QC and R&D employees. Coach and develop the team, assess technical competencies, and maintain training and succession plans. Prepare and control departmental budgets, including testing expenses, equipment requirements, and development resources. Report quality performance, development progress, savings, resource needs, and significant technical risks to management. Maintain effective coordination with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, EHS, Finance, and HR. Qualifications Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Suggested experience: at least eight years in construction chemicals or a closely related manufacturing sector, including three years in a managerial or supervisory role. Demonstrated experience in both formulation development and quality control. Strong knowledge of relevant product technologies, laboratory testing, industrial scale-up, and root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of ISO 9001, applicable product standards, and laboratory safety. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant ERP or laboratory systems; SAP experience is an advantage. Strong communication skills in English and Arabic. Additional Information We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Principal Product Manager
description: Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns About us: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target. The Post Purchase & Returns Product team is responsible for creating seamless, reliable, and differentiated guest experiences after an order is placed. The team builds capabilities across order tracking, fulfillment, order modifications, payments, returns, and refunds, enabling greater transparency, convenience, and control for guests. Through platform modernization, intelligent automation, and innovative digital experiences, we strive to simplify complex post-purchase journeys, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen guest trust and loyalty. About the role: This Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will serve as a senior individual contributor, driving product strategy and execution for critical capabilities within Target's post-purchase ecosystem in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target. As Principal Product Manager, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex post-purchase capabilities, translating guest needs, business priorities, and technology opportunities into scalable solutions. You will drive meaningful improvements in guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes while ensuring products meet enterprise standards for reliability, usability, and scalability. You will lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple business and technology teams, partnering with senior leaders across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Guest Services to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and remove execution barriers. You will influence decisions across interconnected products and platforms, balancing long-term strategic investments with near-term business needs. You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, leveraging guest insights, analytics, experimentation, and competitive intelligence to validate opportunities and inform product decisions. You will establish clear goals and OKRs, assess product health and financial impact, and use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and deliver measurable outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to modernize foundational platforms, improve system reliability, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify post-purchase experiences and operations. As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a product thought leader, influencing product direction across teams, mentoring product managers, and elevating product management practices through expertise, collaboration, and strategic influence rather than direct people management. Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. About you: Four-year degree or equivalent experience. 7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex, enterprise-scale digital products. Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems. Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds. Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities. Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems. Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions. Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success. Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations. Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams. Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities. Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority. Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India. title: Equity Index Data Analyst
description: Equity Index Data Analyst — Job Description Team Overview — Benchmarks & Indices Operations Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks & Indices Operations. We are a client-focused, technology-enabled team producing high-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles. Role Purpose We are recruiting an Equity Index Data Analyst for our EIDM team in Bengaluru. You will manage a broad set of quantitative and qualitative equity data across a global universe of companies, ensuring best-in-class quality and accuracy across all EIDM products. Equities Index Data plays a pivotal role in supporting global index data operations across multiple asset classes (predominantly Equity), ensuring operational continuity, data integrity, and strategic alignment across global teams. Responsibilities Analyse, extract, standardize, and maintain quantitative and qualitative equity data from multiple information sources—including annual reports, company websites, and regulatory filings of public companies. Apply and uphold defined Index policies and ground rules to ensure a high degree of data quality and policy compliance. Perform primary research and calculations for: free float, voting rights, shares in issue (total shares outstanding), nationality, industry classification (ICB), country assignment, universe collation, liquidity testing, and IPO set ups. Conduct primary research during index review periods and draft first responses for client queries, consistent with policy and internal guidance Perform Quality Control (QC) on peer outputs and provide constructive feedback to improve overall quality. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on data issues and drive action plans that prevent recurrence. Identify and recommend automation or process optimization opportunities that reduce effort and risk in data management and analysis. Collaborate with senior team members to implement, test, and document improvements. Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs for all relevant workflows, aligned with risk and governance guidelines. Qualifications Required Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent (MBA, CFA, CA preferred) 1+ years of experience in capital/financial markets, preferably financial research or index operations Hands-on experience with key financial and referential equity datasets—notably entity masters, pricing, and classifications Strong technology literacy: Intermediate MS Office (especially Excel); experience with Power Apps, Power Automate (or similar) Beginner-level SQL Beginner-level familiarity with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini Core Skills Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to interpret and apply Index policies and ground rules consistently Clear written communication (especially for client query drafting) Time management under strict deadlines and cyclical workloads Documentation discipline (SOPs, RCAs, QC feedback) and collaborative mindset Career Stage: Associate LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.
